lines.text: Running payroll shouldn't mean chasing down your entire team.
Meet PayrollPilot. Your AI-powered payroll operations team.
This is a real pay period, on synthetic data, every record labeled. The audit agent finds an already-paid shift logged to the wrong job.
It can't ask anyone, so it hands the case to Resolution, in a shared Band room.
Resolution drafts two questions. The owner approves the exact text, and only then does it send: a real iMessage, in test mode, to the owner's own phone.
A vague yes isn't an answer. Both questions are marked ambiguous, and one bounded follow-up goes out, with a new approval.
The clear reply lands in the right case, quote attached, and the confirmed fact is stored in Cognee.
The owner approves a local correction. Wages don't move; that shift was already paid. Job costing does, and only the affected item changes.
In an earlier verified run, a fresh Payroll Prep process recalled the confirmed fact from Cognee and proposed an allocation for owner approval.
Then Payroll Prep assembles the corrected review: an internal draft, waiting for the owner.
Under the hood, three agents share one model, but not one set of powers. Plain code owns every state change and every approval.
They coordinate in Band: one room, a shared board, every handoff acknowledged, and the owner's decision as a reply in that room.
Each agent's model usage is metered. And memory can change a next action, but it can never grant an approval.
Wages, commissions, tips and the manager pool stay separate, each with named blockers. The workbook is verified. And Gusto: not prepared.
From missing information to payroll-ready. With you in control.
